summary: Risk-on but chips are fading off premarket highs: Nasdaq ~+1.5%, S&P ~+0.9%, Dow flat as CoreWeave's beat lifts AI names while Fed-hike worries linger (bonds closed for Veterans Day). Update: NVDA slipped to ~174 and AMD to ~533 after the open, so NVDA levels were reset and confidence cut, AMD flipped to a gap-fade put, GEV put trimmed on reports it is up ~3%.

picks.name: CoreWeave
picks.reason: Up 11-17% on the Q3 beat (rev 3.66B vs 3.55B) and raised guide; over 58 the gap runs, under the ~54 opening level it fades.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq holding ~+1.5% on the AI rebound; over 686 heads for the 692 Nov 4 close, under 678 the gap fails on hike worries (price estimated from index move).

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Up ~3% at 174 but gave back premarket ~177 amid the CEO probe overhang; reclaiming 177 restarts the relief rally, losing 171.5 fills the gap toward 169.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Gap faded from ~546 premarket to ~533 (+3.5%) and lost 538; under 526 the fade extends toward 515 prior close, back over 541 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Lagging after Tuesday's 2.2% drop on Anthropic Office-style tools while money rotates to chips; under 527 (Tuesday low) selling resumes, over 541 the put is wrong.

picks.name: GE Vernova
picks.reason: Reports conflict (premarket giveback vs. +3% with AI-power names); under 765 extends the giveback, over 790 the put is wrong - low conviction.
